items.question: Trong câu "This is the most misunderstood point.", từ "misunderstood" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most misunderstood point.", what does "misunderstood" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: misunderstood /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstʊd/ (tính từ): bị hiểu sai. "The most misunderstood point" = điểm bị hiểu sai nhiều nhất; động từ gốc là misunderstand (hiểu lầm).
items.explanationEn: misunderstood /ˌmɪs.ʌn.dəˈstʊd/ (adjective): wrongly understood. "The most misunderstood point" is the idea people get wrong most often; the base verb is misunderstand.

items.question: Trong câu "without a plan you have nothing to compare against, so you do not know how far off you are until it is too late.", từ "far off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "without a plan you have nothing to compare against, so you do not know how far off you are until it is too late.", what does "far off" (phrase) mean?
options: ở cách xa về địa lý
lệch nhiều so với mục tiêu
optionsEn: a long time in the future
items.explanation: far off /fɑːr ɒf/ (cụm từ): lệch nhiều so với mục tiêu. "How far off you are" = bạn đang lệch bao nhiêu; "off" ở đây nghĩa là sai lệch, ví dụ "the estimate was way off".
items.explanationEn: far off /fɑːr ɒf/ (phrase): far from the correct target. "How far off you are" means how much you deviate from the target; compare "the estimate was way off".

items.question: Trong câu "without a plan you have nothing to compare against, so you do not know how far off you are until it is too late.", từ "compare against" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "without a plan you have nothing to compare against, so you do not know how far off you are until it is too late.", what does "compare against" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: compare against /kəmˈpeər əˈɡenst/ (cụm từ): đối chiếu với. "Compare against a baseline" = đối chiếu với mốc chuẩn; cũng nói "compare with".
items.explanationEn: compare against /kəmˈpeər əˈɡenst/ (phrase): to check something next to. "Compare against a baseline" means to measure something next to a reference; "compare with" is similar.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop food from going bad
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ nguyên. "Preserve an old plan" = giữ nguyên kế hoạch cũ không cập nhật; "preserve" còn có nghĩa bảo quản thực phẩm.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep unchanged. "Preserve an old plan" means keeping it unchanged; the word also means keeping food from spoiling.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", từ "save face" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", what does "save face" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: save face /seɪv feɪs/ (cụm từ): giữ thể diện. "Save face" = giữ thể diện, tránh bị mất mặt; trái nghĩa là "lose face".
items.explanationEn: save face /seɪv feɪs/ (phrase): to avoid looking bad. "Save face" means to avoid embarrassment or losing respect; the opposite is "lose face".

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", từ "decoration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", what does "decoration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đồ trang trí. "Turn X into decoration" = biến X thành đồ trang trí, tức không còn tác dụng thực tế.
items.explanationEn: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): something just for show. "Turn X into decoration" means making something useful into something only for show.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", từ "instrument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who preserves an old plan to save face has turned a navigation instrument into decoration.", what does "instrument" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (danh từ): dụng cụ, công cụ. "A navigation instrument" = dụng cụ định hướng (như la bàn); "instrument" cũng có nghĩa nhạc cụ.
items.explanationEn: instrument /ˈɪn.strə.mənt/ (noun): a tool or device. "A navigation instrument" is a device such as a compass; the word can also mean a musical instrument.

items.question: Trong câu "A plan is the best model of current understanding, and it must be updated as understanding changes.", từ "current" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A plan is the best model of current understanding, and it must be updated as understanding changes.", what does "current" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: current /ˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): hiện tại. "Current understanding" = hiểu biết hiện tại; danh từ "current" lại có nghĩa dòng điện, dòng chảy.
items.explanationEn: current /ˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): existing now. "Current understanding" is what we know right now; as a noun, "current" means a flow of water or electricity.

items.question: Trong câu "A Work Breakdown Structure divides the whole scope into pieces small enough to estimate, assign, and track.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Work Breakdown Structure divides the whole scope into pieces small enough to estimate, assign, and track.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi công việc. "Scope" = phạm vi công việc của dự án; cụm hay gặp: scope creep, in scope, out of scope.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the work a project covers. "Scope" is the total work a project covers; common phrases: scope creep, in scope, out of scope.

items.question: Trong câu "A Work Breakdown Structure divides the whole scope into pieces small enough to estimate, assign, and track.", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Work Breakdown Structure divides the whole scope into pieces small enough to estimate, assign, and track.", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a task to someone
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): giao (việc). "Assign a task to someone" = giao việc cho ai; danh từ: assignment, assignee (người được giao).
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to give a task to someone. "Assign a task to someone" means giving them responsibility for it; nouns: assignment, assignee.

items.question: Trong câu "Decompose by DELIVERABLE, not by activity.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Decompose by DELIVERABLE, not by activity.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a new order
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): chia nhỏ ra. "Decompose a problem" = chia nhỏ vấn đề; trong sinh học "decompose" nghĩa là phân hủy.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into smaller parts. "Decompose a problem" means splitting it into parts; in biology the word means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "A deliverable can be checked as done or not done; an activity cannot.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A deliverable can be checked as done or not done; an activity cannot.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. "Deliverable" = sản phẩm/kết quả cụ thể phải bàn giao, ví dụ tài liệu, module đã kiểm thử.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output handed over. A "deliverable" is a concrete output you hand over, such as a document or a tested module.

items.question: Trong câu "Child nodes must sum exactly to the parent — nothing missing, nothing added.", từ "sum" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Child nodes must sum exactly to the parent — nothing missing, nothing added.", what does "sum" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: sum /sʌm/ (động từ): cộng lại bằng. "Sum to X" = cộng lại bằng X; "sum up" lại có nghĩa tóm tắt.
items.explanationEn: sum /sʌm/ (verb): to add up to. "Sum to X" means the parts add up to X; "sum up" means to summarize.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the only mechanism that reveals forgotten scope.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the only mechanism that reveals forgotten scope.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Reveal a gap" = làm lộ ra chỗ thiếu; danh từ: revelation.
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make visible. "Reveal a gap" means making a missing part visible; noun: revelation.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the only mechanism that reveals forgotten scope.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the only mechanism that reveals forgotten scope.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a method that makes something work
the moving parts of an engine
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế. "Mechanism" = cơ chế, cách thức vận hành; nghĩa đen là bộ phận máy móc.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (noun): a method that makes something work. "Mechanism" is a process or method that achieves something; literally, it means machine parts.

items.question: Trong câu "each work package should fall between 8 and 80 hours", từ "fall between" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "each work package should fall between 8 and 80 hours", what does "fall between" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall between /fɔːl bɪˈtwiːn/ (cụm từ): nằm trong khoảng. "Fall between A and B" = nằm trong khoảng A đến B; "fall" nghĩa đen là rơi, ngã.
items.explanationEn: fall between /fɔːl bɪˈtwiːn/ (phrase): to be within a range. "Fall between A and B" means being inside that range; literally, "fall" means to drop.

items.question: Trong câu "Smaller and management costs more than it is worth; larger and you cannot tell it is drifting.", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Smaller and management costs more than it is worth; larger and you cannot tell it is drifting.", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): dần lệch hướng. "The project is drifting" = dự án đang dần trượt khỏi kế hoạch mà không ai để ý; nghĩa đen là trôi dạt.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to slowly go off track. "The project is drifting" means it is slowly moving away from plan; literally, to be carried by water or wind.

items.question: Trong câu "Things routinely left out of a WBS — which consume a serious share of budget", từ "routinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Things routinely left out of a WBS — which consume a serious share of budget", what does "routinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên. "Routinely left out" = thường xuyên bị bỏ sót; tính từ: routine (thường lệ).
items.explanationEn: routinely /ruːˈtiːn.li/ (adverb): regularly, as a habit. "Routinely left out" means regularly forgotten; the related noun/adjective is routine.

items.question: Trong câu "Things routinely left out of a WBS — which consume a serious share of budget", từ "share" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Things routinely left out of a WBS — which consume a serious share of budget", what does "share" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (danh từ): phần, tỷ lệ. "A serious share of budget" = một phần đáng kể ngân sách; "share" còn có nghĩa cổ phiếu.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (noun): a portion of a total. "A serious share of budget" is a large portion of it; "share" can also mean a unit of stock.

items.question: Trong câu "Data migration from the legacy system.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data migration from the legacy system.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa. "Legacy system" = hệ thống cũ vẫn đang chạy; danh từ "legacy" còn nghĩa là di sản.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. A "legacy system" is an old system still in use; as a noun, "legacy" means something inherited.

items.question: Trong câu "Integration with third-party systems.", từ "third-party" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integration with third-party systems.", what does "third-party" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: third-party /ˌθɜːdˈpɑː.ti/ (tính từ): của bên thứ ba. "Third-party systems" = hệ thống của bên thứ ba (không phải mình hay khách hàng), ví dụ cổng thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: third-party /ˌθɜːdˈpɑː.ti/ (adjective): made by an outside company. "Third-party systems" come from an outside vendor, not you or the customer, such as a payment gateway.

items.question: Trong câu "There is almost always an answer, and every gap found at this stage is dozens of times cheaper than one found mid-execution.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is almost always an answer, and every gap found at this stage is dozens of times cheaper than one found mid-execution.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): chỗ thiếu sót. "A gap in the plan" = chỗ thiếu sót trong kế hoạch; nghĩa đen là khe hở, khoảng trống.
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a missing part. "A gap in the plan" is something missing from it; literally, "gap" is a space or opening.

items.question: Trong câu "There is almost always an answer, and every gap found at this stage is dozens of times cheaper than one found mid-execution.", từ "execution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is almost always an answer, and every gap found at this stage is dozens of times cheaper than one found mid-execution.", what does "execution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: execution /ˌek.sɪˈkjuː.ʃən/ (danh từ): giai đoạn thực hiện. "Mid-execution" = giữa giai đoạn thực hiện; "execution" còn có nghĩa hành quyết.
items.explanationEn: execution /ˌek.sɪˈkjuː.ʃən/ (noun): the doing of planned work. "Mid-execution" means in the middle of carrying out the work; the word can also mean capital punishment.

items.question: Trong câu "Also distinguish two sources of dependency", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Also distinguish two sources of dependency", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B" = phân biệt A với B; tính từ distinguished lại nghĩa là lỗi lạc.
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" means telling them apart; "distinguished" as an adjective means respected.

items.question: Trong câu "Mandatory — inherent to the work, unbreakable.", từ "inherent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mandatory — inherent to the work, unbreakable.", what does "inherent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inherent /ɪnˈher.ənt/ (tính từ): vốn có, cố hữu. "Inherent to X" = vốn có trong bản chất X; cụm hay gặp: inherent risk (rủi ro cố hữu).
items.explanationEn: inherent /ɪnˈher.ənt/ (adjective): naturally part of something. "Inherent to X" means a natural, built-in part of X; common phrase: inherent risk.

items.question: Trong câu "Mandatory — inherent to the work, unbreakable.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mandatory — inherent to the work, unbreakable.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory dependency" = phụ thuộc bắt buộc; đồng nghĩa: compulsory, required.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required. A "mandatory dependency" cannot be avoided; synonyms: compulsory, required.

items.question: Trong câu "Discretionary — a result of how we chose to work.", từ "discretionary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Discretionary — a result of how we chose to work.", what does "discretionary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: discretionary /dɪˈskreʃ.ən.ər.i/ (tính từ): tùy ý lựa chọn. "Discretionary" = do mình tự quyết; danh từ discretion (quyền tự quyết), còn "discreet" là kín đáo.
items.explanationEn: discretionary /dɪˈskreʃ.ən.ər.i/ (adjective): based on choice. "Discretionary" means left to your own choice; noun: discretion. Do not confuse with "discreet" (tactful).

items.question: Trong câu "These can often be unpicked to run in parallel, and that is the cheapest way to shorten a schedule.", từ "unpick" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These can often be unpicked to run in parallel, and that is the cheapest way to shorten a schedule.", what does "unpick" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: unpick /ʌnˈpɪk/ (động từ): gỡ ra, tách ra. "Unpick a dependency" = gỡ bỏ ràng buộc phụ thuộc; nghĩa đen là tháo đường chỉ may.
items.explanationEn: unpick /ʌnˈpɪk/ (verb): to take apart carefully. "Unpick a dependency" means carefully separating linked work; literally, removing stitches.

items.question: Trong câu "These can often be unpicked to run in parallel, and that is the cheapest way to shorten a schedule.", từ "in parallel" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These can often be unpicked to run in parallel, and that is the cheapest way to shorten a schedule.", what does "in parallel" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (cụm từ): song song cùng lúc. "Run in parallel" = chạy song song; trái nghĩa: "in sequence" (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈpær.ə.lel/ (phrase): at the same time. "Run in parallel" means happening at the same time; the opposite is "in sequence".

items.question: Trong câu "The critical path is the longest dependency chain from project start to finish.", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The critical path is the longest dependency chain from project start to finish.", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi nối tiếp. "Dependency chain" = chuỗi các công việc phụ thuộc nối tiếp nhau; "chain" còn là chuỗi cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a linked series. A "dependency chain" is a series of linked tasks; "chain" also means a group of shops under one brand.

items.question: Trong câu "Work off it has float — slipping within that float costs nothing.", từ "float" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work off it has float — slipping within that float costs nothing.", what does "float" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: float /fləʊt/ (danh từ): thời gian trễ cho phép. "Float" (hay "slack") = thời gian một việc có thể trễ mà không ảnh hưởng ngày kết thúc dự án.
items.explanationEn: float /fləʊt/ (noun): allowed delay time. "Float" (also "slack") is how long a task can slip without moving the project end date.

items.question: Trong câu "When off-path work slips beyond its float, it becomes the new critical path.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When off-path work slips beyond its float, it becomes the new critical path.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ hạn. "The deadline slipped" = hạn chót bị trễ; danh từ "a slip" = sự chậm trễ.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind schedule. "The deadline slipped" means it was missed or delayed; noun: "a schedule slip".

items.question: Trong câu "There are only two legitimate ways to shorten a schedule", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are only two legitimate ways to shorten a schedule", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (tính từ): chính đáng, hợp lệ. "A legitimate way" = cách chính đáng, hợp lệ; trái nghĩa: illegitimate.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (adjective): valid and acceptable. "A legitimate way" is a valid, acceptable way; opposite: illegitimate.

items.question: Trong câu "There are only two legitimate ways to shorten a schedule", từ "shorten" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are only two legitimate ways to shorten a schedule", what does "shorten" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shorten /ˈʃɔː.tən/ (động từ): rút ngắn. "Shorten a schedule" = rút ngắn tiến độ; trái nghĩa: lengthen, extend.
items.explanationEn: shorten /ˈʃɔː.tən/ (verb): to make shorter. "Shorten a schedule" means reducing its total duration; opposite: lengthen, extend.

items.question: Trong câu "crashing (adding resources to critical-path work, which costs money) and fast tracking (running sequential work in parallel, which adds risk)", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "crashing (adding resources to critical-path work, which costs money) and fast tracking (running sequential work in parallel, which adds risk)", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. "Sequential work" = công việc làm tuần tự; danh từ: sequence (trình tự).
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): done one after another. "Sequential work" is done in order, one step after another; noun: sequence.

items.question: Trong câu "crashing (adding resources to critical-path work, which costs money) and fast tracking (running sequential work in parallel, which adds risk)", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "crashing (adding resources to critical-path work, which costs money) and fast tracking (running sequential work in parallel, which adds risk)", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): nguồn lực (người, tiền). "Add resources" = bổ sung nguồn lực (người, máy móc, tiền); cụm: resource allocation.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): people or money for work. "Add resources" means adding people, equipment or money; related: resource allocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Fastest, least accurate, but the only technique usable when you know almost nothing.", từ "usable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fastest, least accurate, but the only technique usable when you know almost nothing.", what does "usable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): dùng được. "Usable when..." = có thể dùng được khi...; danh từ usability (tính dễ dùng).
items.explanationEn: usable /ˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used. "Usable when..." means it can be applied in that situation; noun: usability.

items.question: Trong câu "Apply a factor from historical data", từ "factor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apply a factor from historical data", what does "factor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (danh từ): hệ số. Ở đây "factor" = hệ số nhân (ví dụ 3 ngày mỗi màn hình); nghĩa phổ biến khác là yếu tố.
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (noun): a multiplier. Here "factor" is a multiplier, like 3 days per screen; its other common sense is a contributing element.

items.question: Trong câu "More accurate if your historical data is trustworthy.", từ "historical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More accurate if your historical data is trustworthy.", what does "historical" (adjective) mean?
options: mang tính lịch sử trọng đại
items.explanation: historical /hɪˈstɒr.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): từ quá khứ. "Historical data" = dữ liệu quá khứ; "historic" (không có -al) lại là có ý nghĩa lịch sử lớn.
items.explanationEn: historical /hɪˈstɒr.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): from past records. "Historical data" is data from the past; "historic" means famous or important in history.

items.question: Trong câu "More accurate if your historical data is trustworthy.", từ "trustworthy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More accurate if your historical data is trustworthy.", what does "trustworthy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstˌwɜː.ði/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy. "Trustworthy data" = dữ liệu đáng tin; đồng nghĩa: reliable.
items.explanationEn: trustworthy /ˈtrʌstˌwɜː.ði/ (adjective): reliable. "Trustworthy data" can be relied on; synonym: reliable.

items.question: Trong câu "Most accurate, most time-consuming, and only possible once the WBS exists.", từ "time-consuming" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most accurate, most time-consuming, and only possible once the WBS exists.", what does "time-consuming" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: time-consuming /ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuː.mɪŋ/ (tính từ): tốn thời gian. "Time-consuming" = tốn thời gian; cấu trúc tương tự: resource-consuming.
items.explanationEn: time-consuming /ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuː.mɪŋ/ (adjective): taking a lot of time. "Time-consuming" means needing a lot of time; similar pattern: resource-consuming.

items.question: Trong câu "Take three numbers: optimistic (O), most likely (M), pessimistic (P).", từ "pessimistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Take three numbers: optimistic (O), most likely (M), pessimistic (P).", what does "pessimistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pessimistic /ˌpes.ɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): bi quan. "Pessimistic estimate" = ước tính bi quan (trường hợp xấu); trái nghĩa: optimistic.
items.explanationEn: pessimistic /ˌpes.ɪˈmɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): expecting the worst. A "pessimistic estimate" assumes things go badly; opposite: optimistic.

items.question: Trong câu "That distance is your uncertainty — and it is more important information than the average.", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That distance is your uncertainty — and it is more important information than the average.", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (danh từ): độ không chắc chắn. "Uncertainty" = mức không chắc chắn; cụm: cone of uncertainty (hình nón bất định).
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (noun): lack of sureness. "Uncertainty" is how unsure you are about an outcome; phrase: cone of uncertainty.

items.question: Trong câu "On story points in agile: points measure relative size, not hours.", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On story points in agile: points measure relative size, not hours.", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối. "Relative size" = kích thước tương đối (so với việc khác); danh từ "a relative" là người thân.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrel.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): compared to others. "Relative size" is size judged against other items; as a noun, "a relative" is a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "Points only mean something alongside that team's own velocity, and comparing points between two teams is meaningless.", từ "alongside" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Points only mean something alongside that team's own velocity, and comparing points between two teams is meaningless.", what does "alongside" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (giới từ): cùng với, kèm theo. "Alongside X" = đi kèm/cùng với X; nghĩa đen là ở sát bên cạnh.
items.explanationEn: alongside /əˌlɒŋˈsaɪd/ (preposition): together with. "Alongside X" means together with X; literally, it means next to something.

items.question: Trong câu "Points only mean something alongside that team's own velocity, and comparing points between two teams is meaningless.", từ "meaningless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Points only mean something alongside that team's own velocity, and comparing points between two teams is meaningless.", what does "meaningless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (tính từ): vô nghĩa. "Comparing X is meaningless" = so sánh X là vô nghĩa; trái nghĩa: meaningful.
items.explanationEn: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (adjective): without useful sense. "Comparing X is meaningless" means the comparison tells you nothing; opposite: meaningful.

items.question: Trong câu "when two people estimate three steps apart, the conversation that follows always uncovers a misunderstanding about scope.", từ "uncover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when two people estimate three steps apart, the conversation that follows always uncovers a misunderstanding about scope.", what does "uncover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: uncover /ʌnˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): phát hiện ra. "Uncover a misunderstanding" = phát hiện ra hiểu lầm; nghĩa đen là mở nắp, lật tấm che.
items.explanationEn: uncover /ʌnˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to discover. "Uncover a misunderstanding" means discovering it; literally, removing a cover.

items.question: Trong câu "when two people estimate three steps apart, the conversation that follows always uncovers a misunderstanding about scope.", từ "apart" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "when two people estimate three steps apart, the conversation that follows always uncovers a misunderstanding about scope.", what does "apart" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: apart /əˈpɑːt/ (trạng từ): cách nhau. "Three steps apart" = cách nhau ba bậc; "fall apart" lại là vỡ vụn, sụp đổ.
items.explanationEn: apart /əˈpɑːt/ (adverb): separated by a distance. "Three steps apart" means separated by three steps; "fall apart" means to break into pieces.

items.question: Trong câu "The cone of uncertainty says estimate accuracy improves as information accumulates.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cone of uncertainty says estimate accuracy improves as information accumulates.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích lũy dần. "Information accumulates" = thông tin tích lũy dần; danh từ: accumulation.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to build up over time. "Information accumulates" means more of it builds up over time; noun: accumulation.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important practical consequence: a day-one estimate CANNOT be accurate, no matter how hard you try.", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important practical consequence: a day-one estimate CANNOT be accurate, no matter how hard you try.", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (danh từ): hệ quả. "Practical consequence" = hệ quả thực tế; cụm: as a consequence (do đó).
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒn.sɪ.kwəns/ (noun): a result. A "practical consequence" is a real-world result; phrase: as a consequence (therefore).

items.question: Trong câu "The most important practical consequence: a day-one estimate CANNOT be accurate, no matter how hard you try.", từ "no matter how" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important practical consequence: a day-one estimate CANNOT be accurate, no matter how hard you try.", what does "no matter how" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: no matter how /nəʊ ˈmæt.ər haʊ/ (cụm từ): dù thế nào đi nữa. "No matter how hard you try" = dù cố gắng đến đâu; cấu trúc: no matter what/who/how.
items.explanationEn: no matter how /nəʊ ˈmæt.ər haʊ/ (phrase): however much. "No matter how hard you try" means regardless of effort; pattern: no matter what/who/how.

items.question: Trong câu "The response is not trying to estimate better, but estimating in ranges and recommitting as you learn.", từ "recommit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The response is not trying to estimate better, but estimating in ranges and recommitting as you learn.", what does "recommit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recommit /ˌriː.kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): cam kết lại. "Recommit" = đưa ra cam kết mới dựa trên thông tin mới; gốc "commit to" = cam kết.
items.explanationEn: recommit /ˌriː.kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to promise again. "Recommit" means making a fresh commitment with new information; base: "commit to".

items.question: Trong câu "The response is not trying to estimate better, but estimating in ranges and recommitting as you learn.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The response is not trying to estimate better, but estimating in ranges and recommitting as you learn.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "Estimate in ranges" = ước tính theo khoảng (ví dụ 12–16 tuần); "range" còn là dãy núi.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span of values. "Estimate in ranges" means giving a span like 12–16 weeks; "range" also means a line of mountains.

items.question: Trong câu "How to present an estimate honestly", từ "present" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to present an estimate honestly", what does "present" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: present /prɪˈzent/ (động từ): trình bày. "Present an estimate" = trình bày ước tính; lưu ý trọng âm động từ /prɪˈzent/ khác danh từ /ˈprez.ənt/.
items.explanationEn: present /prɪˈzent/ (verb): to show and explain. "Present an estimate" means to show it to others; the verb is stressed /prɪˈzent/, the noun /ˈprez.ənt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Accepting a cut with nothing else changed is promising something you know is untrue.", từ "untrue" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepting a cut with nothing else changed is promising something you know is untrue.", what does "untrue" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: untrue /ʌnˈtruː/ (tính từ): không đúng sự thật. "Something you know is untrue" = điều bạn biết là sai; đồng nghĩa: false.
items.explanationEn: untrue /ʌnˈtruː/ (adjective): false. "Something you know is untrue" is a claim you know to be false; synonym: false.

items.question: Trong câu "Each person quietly adds 30 percent for safety, the PM adds another 20, and nobody knows the total.", từ "quietly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each person quietly adds 30 percent for safety, the PM adds another 20, and nobody knows the total.", what does "quietly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: quietly /ˈkwaɪət.li/ (trạng từ): âm thầm. "Quietly add" = âm thầm thêm vào mà không ai biết; nghĩa đen là một cách yên lặng.
items.explanationEn: quietly /ˈkwaɪət.li/ (adverb): without telling anyone. "Quietly add" means adding something without telling others; literally, making little noise.

items.question: Trong câu "The right way: estimate honestly, then hold contingency in one VISIBLE place managed by the PM.", từ "contingency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The right way: estimate honestly, then hold contingency in one VISIBLE place managed by the PM.", what does "contingency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (danh từ): khoản dự phòng. "Contingency" = khoản dự phòng cho rủi ro bất ngờ; cụm: contingency plan, contingency reserve.
items.explanationEn: contingency /kənˈtɪn.dʒən.si/ (noun): a reserve for surprises. "Contingency" is a reserve kept for unexpected events; phrases: contingency plan, contingency reserve.

items.question: Trong câu "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer gets consumed without anyone noticing.", từ "transparent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer gets consumed without anyone noticing.", what does "transparent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transparent /trænˈspær.ənt/ (tính từ): công khai, minh bạch. "Transparent buffer" = khoản đệm công khai; nghĩa đen là trong suốt như kính.
items.explanationEn: transparent /trænˈspær.ənt/ (adjective): open for all to see. "Transparent buffer" is a reserve everyone can see; literally, see-through like glass.

items.question: Trong câu "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer gets consumed without anyone noticing.", từ "buffer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer gets consumed without anyone noticing.", what does "buffer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (danh từ): phần đệm dự phòng. "Schedule buffer" = thời gian đệm dự phòng; trong lập trình "buffer" là bộ nhớ đệm.
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌf.ər/ (noun): extra time kept in reserve. A "schedule buffer" is spare time for delays; in programming, a buffer is temporary data storage.

items.question: Trong câu "Once you know you have diverged, four options in the order to consider them", từ "diverge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once you know you have diverged, four options in the order to consider them", what does "diverge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: diverge /daɪˈvɜːdʒ/ (động từ): đi lệch khỏi. "Diverge from the plan" = đi lệch khỏi kế hoạch; trái nghĩa: converge (hội tụ).
items.explanationEn: diverge /daɪˈvɜːdʒ/ (verb): to move away from. "Diverge from the plan" means moving away from it; opposite: converge.

items.question: Trong câu "Three simple but effective indicators", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three simple but effective indicators", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that shows a state
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (danh từ): chỉ số, dấu hiệu. "Indicator" = chỉ số/dấu hiệu cho thấy tình trạng; cụm: key performance indicator (KPI).
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪn.dɪ.keɪ.tər/ (noun): a sign that shows a state. An "indicator" is a sign showing how things stand; phrase: key performance indicator (KPI).

items.question: Trong câu "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", từ "consecutive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", what does "consecutive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (tính từ): liên tiếp. "Three consecutive weeks" = ba tuần liên tiếp; đồng nghĩa: in a row.
items.explanationEn: consecutive /kənˈsek.jə.tɪv/ (adjective): in a row. "Three consecutive weeks" means three weeks in a row; synonym: successive.

items.question: Trong câu "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", từ "on its own" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", what does "on its own" (phrase) mean?
options: tự nó, không cần can thiệp
một mình, cô đơn lẻ loi
theo ý muốn riêng của nó
items.explanation: on its own /ɒn ɪts əʊn/ (cụm từ): tự nó, không cần can thiệp. "Will not speed up on its own" = sẽ không tự nhanh lên nếu không can thiệp; tương tự "by itself".
items.explanationEn: on its own /ɒn ɪts əʊn/ (phrase): without outside help. "Will not speed up on its own" means it won't improve without action; similar: "by itself".

items.question: Trong câu "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", từ "trend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "three consecutive weeks 10 percent behind is a trend, and the fourth week will not speed up on its own.", what does "trend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trend /trend/ (danh từ): xu hướng. "A trend" = xu hướng lặp lại theo thời gian; "trendy" lại là hợp mốt.
items.explanationEn: trend /trend/ (noun): a general direction. "A trend" is a pattern that continues over time; "trendy" means fashionable.

items.question: Trong câu "Having spent 60 percent of budget for 40 percent of scope is a red flag, even while the schedule still looks on time.", từ "red flag" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Having spent 60 percent of budget for 40 percent of scope is a red flag, even while the schedule still looks on time.", what does "red flag" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: red flag /ˌred ˈflæɡ/ (cụm từ): dấu hiệu cảnh báo. "A red flag" = dấu hiệu cảnh báo có vấn đề; trái nghĩa vui: "green flag" (dấu hiệu tốt).
items.explanationEn: red flag /ˌred ˈflæɡ/ (phrase): a warning sign. "A red flag" is a warning that something is wrong; informal opposite: "green flag".

items.question: Trong câu "Having spent 60 percent of budget for 40 percent of scope is a red flag, even while the schedule still looks on time.", từ "on time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Having spent 60 percent of budget for 40 percent of scope is a red flag, even while the schedule still looks on time.", what does "on time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on time /ɒn taɪm/ (cụm từ): đúng tiến độ. "On time" = đúng hạn, không trễ; khác "in time" = kịp lúc (trước khi quá muộn).
items.explanationEn: on time /ɒn taɪm/ (phrase): not late. "On time" means at the planned time, not late; "in time" means before it is too late.

items.question: Trong câu "A milestone three months away makes everyone defer; milestones every two to four weeks force the truth out early.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A milestone three months away makes everyone defer; milestones every two to four weeks force the truth out early.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): trì hoãn. "Defer" = trì hoãn; "defer to someone" lại là nghe theo ý người khác.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to put off until later. "Defer" means to postpone; "defer to someone" means to accept their opinion.

items.question: Trong câu "A milestone three months away makes everyone defer; milestones every two to four weeks force the truth out early.", từ "milestone" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A milestone three months away makes everyone defer; milestones every two to four weeks force the truth out early.", what does "milestone" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stəʊn/ (danh từ): mốc quan trọng. "Milestone" = mốc quan trọng trong dự án; nghĩa đen là cột cây số bên đường.
items.explanationEn: milestone /ˈmaɪl.stəʊn/ (noun): a key checkpoint. A "milestone" is a key point in a project; literally, a stone marking distance on a road.

items.question: Trong câu "Almost always the least damaging, if the backlog is ordered", từ "damaging" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Almost always the least damaging, if the backlog is ordered", what does "damaging" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: damaging /ˈdæm.ɪ.dʒɪŋ/ (tính từ): gây tổn hại. "The least damaging option" = lựa chọn ít gây tổn hại nhất; động từ: damage.
items.explanationEn: damaging /ˈdæm.ɪ.dʒɪŋ/ (adjective): causing harm. "The least damaging option" causes the least harm; verb: damage.

items.question: Trong câu "When sequential work is not genuinely required to be sequential", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When sequential work is not genuinely required to be sequential", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (trạng từ): thực sự. "Not genuinely required" = không thực sự bắt buộc; tính từ: genuine (thật, chân thành).
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn.li/ (adverb): truly. "Not genuinely required" means not truly necessary; adjective: genuine.

items.question: Trong câu "When money and available people exist, with time left for them to ramp up", từ "ramp up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When money and available people exist, with time left for them to ramp up", what does "ramp up" (phrase) mean?
options: dần đạt năng suất đầy đủ
optionsEn: to get up to full speed
items.explanation: ramp up /ræmp ʌp/ (cụm từ): dần đạt năng suất đầy đủ. "Ramp up" = dần đạt năng suất đầy đủ (người mới vào dự án cần thời gian ramp up); danh từ: ramp-up.
items.explanationEn: ramp up /ræmp ʌp/ (phrase): to get up to full speed. "Ramp up" means gradually reaching full productivity, as new team members must; noun: ramp-up.

items.question: Trong câu "A milestone slip flagged six weeks ahead is a problem to manage; the same slip flagged three days ahead is a crisis and a loss of trust.", từ "flag" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A milestone slip flagged six weeks ahead is a problem to manage; the same slip flagged three days ahead is a crisis and a loss of trust.", what does "flag" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flag /flæɡ/ (động từ): báo trước, cảnh báo. "Flag a risk" = báo lên/cảnh báo một rủi ro; "flag" (nội động từ) còn nghĩa là mệt mỏi, uể oải.
items.explanationEn: flag /flæɡ/ (verb): to point out a problem. "Flag a risk" means raising it for attention; intransitively, "flag" also means to become tired.

items.question: Trong câu "A milestone slip flagged six weeks ahead is a problem to manage; the same slip flagged three days ahead is a crisis and a loss of trust.", từ "crisis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A milestone slip flagged six weeks ahead is a problem to manage; the same slip flagged three days ahead is a crisis and a loss of trust.", what does "crisis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: crisis /ˈkraɪ.sɪs/ (danh từ): khủng hoảng. "A crisis" = khủng hoảng; số nhiều là crises /ˈkraɪ.siːz/.
items.explanationEn: crisis /ˈkraɪ.sɪs/ (noun): a very serious situation. "A crisis" is a time of serious danger or difficulty; plural: crises.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning exists to detect deviation early, so it must be continuously updated rather than defended.", từ "deviation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning exists to detect deviation early, so it must be continuously updated rather than defended.", what does "deviation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deviation /ˌdiː.viˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự sai lệch. "Detect deviation" = phát hiện sai lệch; động từ: deviate from (lệch khỏi).
items.explanationEn: deviation /ˌdiː.viˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a difference from the plan. "Detect deviation" means spotting a gap between plan and reality; verb: deviate from.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning exists to detect deviation early, so it must be continuously updated rather than defended.", từ "defend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning exists to detect deviation early, so it must be continuously updated rather than defended.", what does "defend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defend /dɪˈfend/ (động từ): bảo vệ, bênh vực. "Defend a plan" = bênh vực kế hoạch dù nó sai; danh từ: defence/defense.
items.explanationEn: defend /dɪˈfend/ (verb): to argue for. "Defend a plan" means arguing that it is right even when it is not; noun: defence.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates must be presented as ranges with assumptions, because the cone of uncertainty is a law rather than a weakness.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates must be presented as ranges with assumptions, because the cone of uncertainty is a law rather than a weakness.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "List assumptions" = liệt kê các giả định; động từ: assume.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something taken as true. "List assumptions" means writing down what you take as true; verb: assume.

items.question: Trong câu "Planning poker earns its keep because a three-step gap always reveals a scope misunderstanding.", từ "earn its keep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Planning poker earns its keep because a three-step gap always reveals a scope misunderstanding.", what does "earn its keep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: earn its keep /ɜːn ɪts kiːp/ (cụm từ): đáng công sức bỏ ra. "Earn its keep" = xứng đáng với công sức/chi phí bỏ ra; thường nói về công cụ, quy trình.
items.explanationEn: earn its keep /ɜːn ɪts kiːp/ (phrase): to be worth its cost. "Earn its keep" means being useful enough to justify its cost; often said of tools or practices.

items.question: Trong câu "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer disappears unnoticed.", từ "unnoticed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Transparent buffer can be managed; hidden buffer disappears unnoticed.", what does "unnoticed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unnoticed /ʌnˈnəʊ.tɪst/ (tính từ): không ai để ý. "Disappear unnoticed" = biến mất mà không ai để ý; cụm: go unnoticed.
items.explanationEn: unnoticed /ʌnˈnəʊ.tɪst/ (adjective): without being seen. "Disappear unnoticed" means vanishing without anyone seeing; phrase: go unnoticed.
